clock_triggers.trigger_evaluation_rule: Each trigger is evaluated exactly once, at the stated instant, from stage-receipt status and the clock ONLY. Plans escalate MONOTONICALLY: a later trigger may move only to a more reduced plan, never back to a fuller one, and never on the basis of how any result looks. Every evaluation and its inputs are recorded in deadline_decision_receipt.json.

CP0_III_B_DEFERRAL.derivation: PHASE2_START reference + 24 h; the earliest instant at which a lag is distinguishable from ordinary variance
CP0_III_B_DEFERRAL.required_milestone: task I10 COMPLETE (the extraction and serialization spine)
CP0_III_B_DEFERRAL.why_those_are_never_deferred: They are SHARED_A_B and prospectively mandatory: III-A qualification gate 12 is defined in terms of the IB02 primitive and guarded by the IB03 regression fixture. Deferring them stops III-A.

CP1_DROP_BELOW_NORMAL.derivation: ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENT_DEADLINE minus the NORMAL conservative post-A2 tail (55.00 h)

realizable_implementation_hours_saved_at.note: the deletable depth work is built early, so most of the nominal saving is already spent by this instant - the real saving is in the tail

CP2_DROP_BELOW_10_2.derivation: ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENT_DEADLINE minus the PLAN_10_2 conservative post-A2 tail (47.40 h)

CP3_DISASTER.derivation: ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENT_DEADLINE minus the PLAN_10_3 conservative post-A2 tail (43.20 h). Past this instant no frozen plan can capture, extract, analyse and lock before the hard stop.

rule.statement: At each checkpoint instant T, if A2 STATIC_VALIDATION is not PASS, select the LARGEST frozen plan P whose CONSERVATIVE post-A2 tail still fits the remaining budget: tail(P, conservative) <= (ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENT_DEADLINE - T). If no plan qualifies, select PLAN_10_4 DISASTER.
rule.uses_conservative_tail_deliberately: The tail is evaluated at CONSERVATIVE, not nominal, so a checkpoint never selects a plan that only closes if execution happens to go well.

supersedes.defect: The superseded instants were asserted rather than derived, and they selected plans whose implementation savings were never quantified. Each new instant is the deadline minus that plan's own conservative tail.

MEASUREMENT.fir_label_formula: label[t] = sum_{lag} taps[lag] * position[t-lag]; require t - len(taps) + 1 >= 0
MEASUREMENT.fir_normalization: MANDATORY AND FROZEN: normalized_kernel[k] = taps[k] / math.fsum(taps), accumulated with math.fsum. Taps are nonnegative (RIGHT_TO_LEFT tap 8 is the exact float -0.0 and is treated as +0.0). Normalization is applied ONCE, at load, before any label construction, any H(m), any S(tau), any gbar and any oracle quantity. Unnormalized taps are forbidden.
MEASUREMENT.target_eligibility_rule: FROZEN_MANIFEST_ROW_MEMBERSHIP AND COUNTERFACTUAL_EXTENT_FULLY_OCCLUDED AND COMPLETE_ALIGNMENT AND COMPLETE_FIR_HISTORY
